{{Top|leg}}
A '''DataLink transceiver''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] component that allowed units such as [[Multi-Environment Mining Droid MEMD-2]]s to be directed from nearby [[Resource Recon Speeder]]s or [[Mining/Legends|mining]] stations.
